'''''Eshowe Squadron''''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]] of 2 [[R-41 Starchaser]]s used by [[Rneekii]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. They were deployed to provide cover for [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|transport]] group [[Ibutho group|Ibutho]] which were attempting to board and capture [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|Modified corvette]] group [[Hashim group|Hashim]]. The pirates were unsuccessful and were destroyed by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
